subject: Insurance
title: Loss Ratios and Combined Ratios
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Loss Ratios and Combined Ratios.

hook.text: A loss ratio of 60% means 60 cents of every premium dollar goes to claims.

discovery.text: The combined ratio adds expenses to losses. Below 100% means underwriting profit.

twist.text: Many insurers operate above 100% on purpose. They lose money on underwriting but profit from investing the premiums.

climax.text: The combined ratio is insurance's scoreboard.

quiz.question: What does a combined ratio above 100% indicate?
options: The insurer is losing money on underwriting
